College pays up to $2,000 for relocation expenses Start Date : As soon as feasible, Applications will be reviewed as received Salary Hire Range: $107,000 – 152,000 annually for each 12-month appointment (actual amount depends on education and experience) Job Summary: The Chief Financial Officer (CFO)/Associate Vice President (AVP) of Administrative Services has a critical role as the senior financial executive for the college and assists with the oversight of the administrative functions for the college. The position provides executive leadership, oversight, accountability, and strategic direction for the College’s financial operations. The position requires visionary leadership for the college’s financial and operational functions. The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) serves as the College’s senior financial executive and strategic advisor to the President and Board of Trustees. The position provides leadership and oversight in assigned operational areas, which may include facilities and maintenance, grounds, custodial services, transportation, safety and security, purchasing, auxiliary operations, risk management, contracts, capital projects, budgeting support, and other institutional administrative functions. The Associate Vice President works closely with the Vice President for Administrative Services and other executive leadership to support the College’s mission, strategic goals, fiscal sustainability, operational effectiveness, compliance obligations, and campus service environment. This role is in charge of budget development and execution, working capital management, financial reporting, audit coordination, internal controls, procurement, grant management, long-range financial planning, and strategic financial analysis, while ensuring compliance with Wyoming statutes, Wyoming Community College Commission (WCCC) requirements, federal regulations, and Board policy. The CFO oversees the Business Office including the Director, Accounts Payable, and Accounts Receivable.
